rules.title: Revised Attack Powers
rules.description: Use the revised attack powers printed in this chapter in place of their published versions. The lists include powers available through level 11 and their scaling through that level. A level-based improvement to a power you know applies automatically unless the list says it requires a higher-level power slot. Utility power choices follow the book's normal utility rules.

limitations: Shared authoring definition; runtime interpretation and combat effects are not implemented by this migration.
